Subject: Re: Internal: GreenBank evidence request — what artifacts can infra produce?

Folks —

We can produce everything requested, with the following caveats and notes:

1) Deletion workflow (short): user delete -> metadata tombstone created in catalog service -> tombstone replicated asynchronously to regional metadata stores -> background GC/expunge job removes objects and writes audit events. Snapshots are immutable but we tombstone the snapshot and then expunge the underlying object blobs once all references are cleared.

2) Typical timings (production observations):
   - Tombstone replication: within 1–5 minutes across the same region, up to ~15 minutes cross-region under normal load.
   - Expunge job cadence: primary expunge sweep every 6 hours, incremental background sweeps can pick references up sooner. Worst-case observed time-to-final-expunge: ~48 hours in heavily loaded or retry scenarios.

3) Offsite/archival vaults: cross-region vault copy (cold) follows the snapshot lifecycle; expunge from vaults is governed by a separate asynchronous job (vault-expunger) and can take up to 7 days to fully remove objects depending on retention and legal hold states. We will mark that in the attestation.

4) Legal hold: if GreenBank placed a hold any time during the sample window, expunge is blocked and will show as "hold_pending" in the manifest.

I attached the raw expunge run log for 2026-08-30 that corresponds to the sample snapshot set (redacted paths).

Attachments: expunge_run_20260830.log

Action items:
- I can produce a CSV manifest (snapshot metadata + expunge timestamps) for the sample snapshot by EOD tomorrow.
- Laura/Neha: can you confirm required language for the auditor-facing attestation? We should include the worst-case numbers above and a signed statement.

-Aditya
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
